subsetPolicyRationale: `s.lowpoly.lowpoly@1` is this plugin's own self-contained low-poly mesh document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-object, delete-object, reorder-objects, rename-object, change-object-smooth-shading, move-object, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
